verses: I also saw the soul of a lazy man, whom they called Davanos, whose whole body a noxious creature ever gnawed, and his right foot was not gnawed.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of the lazy Davanos who, when he was in the world, never did any good work; but with this right foot, a bundle of grass was cast before a ploughing ox.'
